descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Nightclub Simulator VR 1.0 is here!**

The biggest NCS update yet brings the new **Story Mode**, alongside the sandbox chaos, mods, and unpredictable moments that make every night different.

Step into **Story Mode** and experience a new side of Nightclub Simulator, or jump back into the sandbox and run the night your own way. Customize your look, interact with NPCs, stir up trouble, and see where the night takes you.

📖 Experience the new Story Mode  
🎭 Change your look with Mod NPC appearances  
👏 Hype the crowd or stir up trouble  
🛠️ Explore mods and bring more variety into the club  
🙌 Play and create chaos with friends  
🗺️ Explore different maps and make the night your own  

**Version 1.0 brings the new Story Mode together with the sandbox chaos, mods, and unpredictable moments that define Nightclub Simulator VR.**

Follow the story, create your own chaos, or just see where the night takes you.
